notablePrerequisites: Necrogen Communion attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Shepherd of the Cosmos trigger, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
